title: MannaRites Gold
description:
Retro-style FANTASY BEAT'EM'UP / HACK'N'SLASH, inspired by classic cult games of 90s! Gore, weapons, armor, skills - what's not to love? 

Gold edition of the original game - MannaRites - which was warmly received by players:

 90% on Steam, 4.7 on Google Play

Why Gold Edition though? Why pay for a free game?
Well, Gold edition is created to rethink and refine some of the gameplay features and balance of the original game and to add some asked features! And also - well, let's be honest here - to raise some financial support for the Chapter 2 development! So if you're waiting for C2 - please consider supporting us by getting the Gold edition! 
 

Play alone or with a friend and, as mighty WARRIOR, agile ACROBAT or powerful MAGUS, master the art of fighting. Game features three levels of difficulty - for new players, veterans and seasoned hardcore players. Fully original soundtrack and voiced dialogues will help you to immerse yourself into the mysterious world of Ijmeria and defend your people against brutal invaders! 

 

• unique FANTASY setting 

• skill-based combat with special moves, throws, blocks and ripostes

• army of enemies with unique behavior and combat moves

• hours long story-driven adventure, featuring NPCs and quests

• fully voiced dialogues

• open map to explore and choose your path

• loot system - weapons, armor, potions and items to find, equip and use

• RPG system - combat moves, skills and perks to master

• original soundtrack
description_short: Classic hack'n'slash / beat'em'up experience with a layer of skills / loot / exploration on top! If you're a fan of classic hack'n'slash games like Golden Axe - this game is for you!
